capsule-api.name: ConcurrentMapCapsule
capsule-api.description:
Generic lockfree concurrent hash map using linear probing with atomic CAS operations. Provides 3-59x speedup over std::HashMap and DashMap.
**Key Characteristics**: - 16K entry capacity (2MB memory footprint) - <100ns insert, <50ns get (lockfree atomic operations) - Linear probing with max 256 probe distance - Generation counters for TOCTOU prevention - AtomicPtr-based value storage (Box allocation) - 128-byte cache-aligned entries (prevent false sharing)
**UCE34 Tier Classification**: - Primary: T4 Batch (16K entry array with linear probing) - Secondary: T1 Atomic (CAS operations for concurrent updates)
**Use Cases**: - Subscription registries - Connection pools - Cache implementations - Session storage - Configuration maps

type-parameters.param: Key type - must be hashable, comparable, cloneable, and thread-safe
Value type - must be thread-safe for concurrent access

constants.constant: Maximum linear probing distance before giving up

entry-structure.name: MapEntry<K, V>
entry-structure.field: Hash of key (0 = empty, u64::MAX = tombstone)
Pointer to heap-allocated key (null if empty/tombstone)
Pointer to heap-allocated value (null if empty/tombstone)

memory-layout.alignment: 128 bytes (2x cache line for entry isolation)

constructor.name: new
constructor.description: Creates new concurrent map with default capacity (16K entries)

constructor.name: with_capacity
constructor.description: Creates new concurrent map with specified capacity

parameters.param: Number of slots (rounded up to power of 2 for efficient modulo)

postconditions.condition: Actual capacity is next power of 2 >= requested

method.name: get
method.signature: pub fn get<Q>(&self, key: &Q) -> Option<&V> where K: Borrow<Q>, Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized
method.description: Returns reference to value associated with key

parameters.param: Key to look up (can be borrowed type)

postconditions.condition: Returns None if key not found

method.algorithm: 1. Compute hash(key) 2. Calculate initial slot index: hash % capacity 3. Linear probe up to MAX_PROBE_DISTANCE slots: - Load slot hash (Acquire) - If hash matches: compare keys, return value if equal - If EMPTY_SLOT: key not found, return None - If TOMBSTONE or different hash: continue probing 4. Return None if max probe exceeded

method.name: contains_key
method.signature: pub fn contains_key<Q>(&self, key: &Q) -> bool where K: Borrow<Q>, Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized
method.description: Returns true if map contains the key

postconditions.condition: Returns count at time of call (may be stale)

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns true if map contains no entries

method.name: insert
method.signature: pub fn insert(&self, key: K, value: V) -> Option<V>
method.description: Inserts key-value pair, returning previous value if key existed
method.thread-safety: SWeMR (single writer preferred, CAS retry on contention)

preconditions.condition: Map is not at capacity (len < capacity - PROBE_SLACK)

postconditions.condition: Key-value pair visible to subsequent reads
len incremented by 1 if new key
Returns None if key was new

method.algorithm: 1. Compute hash(key), ensure not EMPTY_SLOT (0) or TOMBSTONE (u64::MAX) 2. Calculate initial slot index 3. Linear probe for empty/tombstone or matching key: - CAS to claim slot (EMPTY/TOMBSTONE -> hash) - On success: store key_ptr, value_ptr (Release) - On CAS failure: retry probe 4. If matching key found: CAS update value_ptr 5. Increment len atomically if new key 6. Return previous value (if any)
method.errors: Returns None and does nothing if map is full (capacity exceeded)

method.name: remove
method.signature: pub fn remove<Q>(&self, key: &Q) -> Option<V> where K: Borrow<Q>, Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized
method.description: Removes and returns value for key

postconditions.condition: Returns None if key not found
len decremented by 1 if key existed

method.algorithm: 1. Find slot containing key (same as get) 2. CAS hash from key_hash -> TOMBSTONE 3. Load and null out key_ptr, value_ptr 4. Decrement len atomically 5. Deallocate key and value Boxes 6. Return removed value

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all entries from the map

method.name: entry
method.signature: pub fn entry(&self, key: K) -> Entry<'_, K, V>
method.description: Gets entry for in-place mutation (insert-or-update pattern)

parameters.param: Key to get or create entry for

postconditions.condition: Returns Entry::Vacant if key not found

method.name: or_insert
method.signature: pub fn or_insert(&self, key: K, default: V) -> &V
method.description: Inserts default value if key doesn't exist, returns reference to value

postconditions.condition: Key exists with either existing or default value

method.name: or_insert_with
method.signature: pub fn or_insert_with<F>(&self, key: K, f: F) -> &V where F: FnOnce() -> V
method.description: Inserts value from closure if key doesn't exist (lazy evaluation)

postconditions.condition: Closure only called if key was not present
Key exists with either existing or computed value

method.name: iter
method.description: Returns iterator over all key-value pairs

postconditions.condition: Iterates over entries present at iteration start
May miss entries added during iteration
May include entries removed during iteration (weak consistency)

connections.description: How ConcurrentMapCapsule connects to other capsules

input.description: Stores session data and connection state

input.protocol: insert on connect, remove on disconnect

output.protocol: get for cache hits, insert for cache population

invariants.invariant: All operations are wait-free or lock-free (no blocking)
Generation counter increases monotonically on mutations
No slot hash equals EMPTY_SLOT (0) or TOMBSTONE (u64::MAX) for valid keys
Entry alignment is 128 bytes (verified at compile time)
key_ptr and value_ptr are both null or both non-null

assum-tags.description: Safety assumptions and verifications per ASSUM framework

assume.text: Max 256 hops prevents infinite loops and bounds worst-case latency

verify.text: Property tests validate probe distance bounds at 90% load factor

assume.text: AtomicPtr prevents data races on key/value access
assume.location: key_ptr and value_ptr fields in MapEntry

verify.text: 1000-thread concurrent stress tests verify no data races

assume.text: Generation counter prevents TOCTOU races in CAS loops

verify.text: Property tests verify generation monotonicity under contention

assume.text: Hash function never produces 0 (EMPTY_SLOT) or u64::MAX (TOMBSTONE)

verify.text: Hash values transformed: if 0 -> 1, if MAX -> MAX-1

assume.text: 128-byte entry alignment prevents false sharing between entries

claims.claim: Lockfree atomic operations vs lock acquisition
